topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% antenna efficiency reduces effective aperture area, increasing noise temperature and decreasing signal-to-noise ratio. This impacts link budget by requiring increased transmit power to maintain reliability, straining power constraints and potentially reducing capacity due to increased interference in GEO-LEO links.
reference_context: Link budget calculations consider power constraints, antenna gains, and noise temperatures to ensure reliable transmission in satellite links.
